subject.title: fix(clickclack): recover when API requests stall

question: Should ClickClack control-plane REST calls adopt the proposed 30-second response-header and response-body-idle budgets for all existing deployments?
rationale: The code is narrowly scoped and preserves multipart upload behavior, but selecting a universal timeout budget changes the observable failure mode for slow self-hosted ClickClack servers and intermediaries.

options.title: Confirm the 30-second budgets
options.body: Merge the bounded header and JSON-body idle timeouts as the supported ClickClack control-plane contract.

options.title: Use different documented budgets
options.body: Request a follow-up revision with owner-selected limits and matching coverage for the intended deployment envelope.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 30-second budgets
recommendation.body: Merge the bounded header and JSON-body idle timeouts as the supported ClickClack control-plane contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the channel-specific REST behavior and can determine the supported latency contract for ClickClack deployments.
